close_reason: Implemented a bounded cancel/terminal-result/reap shutdown barrier, linked monitored TUI workers, bounded concurrent extension and coding resource closure, runtime-owner termination, safe terminal draw/close normalization, and OTP partial-open cleanup bytes. Commit 7fdfdc8. Validation: 283 tests passed; 83.6% coverage; Credo, Dialyzer, Doctor, docs, dependency lock, and production escript smoke passed.
description: Repository: jido_cli. On EOF, draw failure, startup failure, or exit, cancel active work, wait for a bounded terminal result, close extension and coding resources, and restore the terminal. Acceptance: resources open and close exactly once; no child remains; terminal cleanup bytes are always emitted.
title: Add bounded cancel-and-close resource shutdown
